name: Speedway Challenge 2025
description:
About This Game

Put your kevlar and helmet on, get on your motorcycle without brakes and hit the track for glory in the "Speedway Challenge 2025" game! This product will allow you to fulfill all your speedway dreams - become the next world champion, as well as lead your beloved club to the league pedestal. The path of your individual or club career is up to you.

Game modes waiting for the player:

- Quick Match - a quick way to stand with your rivals under the tape and fight a fierce battle for victory! Choose the teams, indicate the location and go, because the referee has started the two-minute clock, so it would be a shame to be late for the first race.

- Career (after in app purchase) - create a new virtual rider or choose one of over a thousand available riders and lead his career according to your own discretion. It's up to you whether you'll become a speedway globetrotter or lead a quiet life and riding once or twice a week.

- League (after in app purchase) - build a club from scratch or choose one of the available centers and lead it to the very top in one of several European leagues. Make sure to have a team that complies with the regulations, but remember to be able to afford the salaries. The medal will be the summary of your hard work.

- Challenges - accept the challenge and do the task that awaits you. Achieve a specific result as a team or individually, win expected number of times or do not let the rival achieve a significant score.

- Online - test your skills in a confrontation with players from all around the world in the ranking game or invite a group of friends (after in app purchase) to play together.

You will compete on almost 70 tracks from all over the world - from South America, through the Antipodes to Europe, with competitors who have been precisely reproduced in terms of skill level and riding silhouette. Each competition will be held in accordance with the applicable rules of speedway sport.
short_desc: Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?
